title: Census Geocoder (addresses and coordinates to census geographies)
questions: the census tract and county of an address
the coordinates of a street address
which congressional district a point is in
the FIPS codes of an address, to join census or health data

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the JSON under the name shown, then upload the files. Without the links: https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/ (Find Locations or Find Geographies, by address or coordinates) shows the same match; batches of up to 10,000 addresses go through its Address Batch form.

cache.why: Address ranges and boundaries are updated with each benchmark and vintage; each analysis asks again and records which benchmark and vintage it used.

redistribution.why: Census Bureau data products are U.S. government works in the public domain; the API terms ask for the statement that the product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

notices: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Census Geocoder, {dataset}, geocoding.geo.census.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which boundaries: current (benchmark Public_AR_Current, vintage Current_Current), or those of a census or ACS year (e.g. vintage Census2020_Current, ACS2025_Current) to join data of that year? Default: the vintage of the data the codes will be joined to.
